paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Nachmani, Resh Lakish's interpreter: Ketubot, chapter 1, 8b, 16b; Chagigah 16a, two expositions; Gittin 60b has bar Nachmoni in the received report [the checked text reads bar Nachmani]; Sotah 37b; Temurah 14b. Shemot Rabbah, section 47, in Resh Lakish's name [the checked passage names the transmitter Yehudah bar Nachman]: Moses wrote, passed what remained in the pen over his head, and from it received rays of splendor. Shocher Tov on Samuel, chapter 9, has ben Nachman in Resh Lakish's name.
